skill_01.name: Console Application Developer
skill_01.description: Build command-line tools, scripts, and terminal applications using Dictum's natural-language syntax. Master printing, variables, arithmetic, conditionals, loops, arrays, functions, and structs.
skill_01.example_snippet:
program Calculator:
    action add takes A as whole number, B as whole number produces whole number:
        produce success with the sum of A and B
    end action

    keep Result as whole number
    call add with 5 and 3 giving Result
    print the text "5 + 3 = " and Result and newline
end program

skill_02.name: Memory Management Specialist
skill_02.description: Master manual memory management, dynamic allocation, pointer arithmetic, and ownership tracking. Build custom allocators and data structures from scratch.
dictum_features: handle to bytes with room for
skill_02.example_snippet:
program BufferDemo:
    keep Buffer as handle to bytes with room for 1024

    unsafe:
        keep Ptr as * byte
        put transmute Buffer as * byte into Ptr
        put 65 into Index at 0 of Ptr
    end unsafe

    print the text "First byte: " and Index at 0 of Buffer and newline
    release Buffer
end program

skill_03.name: File Systems Engineer
skill_03.description: Work with file I/O, binary data, directory traversal, path manipulation, and memory-mapped files. Build utilities like grep, find, and hex dumpers.
deliverables: File copy utility with progress bar
skill_03.example_snippet:
program FileCopy:
    import from C the action fopen takes text, text produces handle to bytes as file_open
    import from C the action fread takes handle to bytes, count, count, handle to bytes produces count as file_read

    keep Source as handle to bytes
    put call file_open with "input.txt" and "rb" into Source

    keep Buffer as handle to bytes with room for 4096
    keep BytesRead as count
    put call file_read with Buffer and 1 and 4096 and Source into BytesRead

    print the text "Read " and BytesRead and " bytes" and newline
end program

skill_04.name: Process & IPC Developer
skill_04.description: Create multi-process applications using fork, exec, pipes, and signals. Build job schedulers, process monitors, and inter-process communication systems.
dictum_features: C imports for fork, exec, pipe
skill_04.example_snippet:
program ForkDemo:
    import from C the action fork produces whole number as spawn_process
    import from C the action waitpid takes whole number, handle to bytes, whole number produces whole number as wait_child

    keep PID as whole number
    put call spawn_process into PID

    if PID is equal to 0 then:
        print the text "Child process running" and newline
    otherwise:
        print the text "Parent waiting for child..." and newline
        call wait_child with PID and nothing and 0
        print the text "Child finished" and newline
    end if
end program

skill_05.description: Build TCP/UDP clients and servers, HTTP handlers, and custom protocol implementations. Understand sockets, packet structures, and network security basics.

    print the text "Server socket created: " and Sock and newline

    print the text "Listening on port 8080..." and newline
end program

skill_06.name: Threading & Concurrency Expert
skill_06.description: Master multi-threading, synchronization primitives, lock-free data structures, and thread pools. Build high-performance concurrent systems.

    end repeat

skill_11.description: Connect devices to the internet via WiFi, BLE, LoRa, or cellular. Implement MQTT, HTTP, CoAP protocols for IoT communication.

skill_13.name: Robotics Control Engineer

    call dictum_pid_init with 2.0 and 0.5 and 0.1 and PID1

end program

skill_17.name: Compiler Engineer

skill_20.name: Audio / DSP Engineer
skill_20.description: Process audio signals, implement filters, FFT, and real-time audio pipelines. Build synthesizers, effects, and analysis tools.
dictum_features: Raw handle to T for audio buffers
skill_20.example_snippet:
program SineWave:
    keep SampleRate as whole number with value 44100
    keep Frequency as fractional number with value 440.0
    keep Duration as whole number with value 1
    keep NumSamples as whole number
    put the product of SampleRate and Duration into NumSamples

    keep Buffer as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of NumSamples and 8

    unsafe:
        keep Ptr as * fractional number
        put transmute Buffer as * fractional number into Ptr

        repeat NumSamples times using I:
            keep T as fractional number
            put the quotient of I and SampleRate into T
            keep Sample as fractional number
            put call dictum_math_sin with the product of the product of 6.28318 and Frequency and T into Sample
            put Sample into Index at I of Ptr
        end repeat
    end unsafe

    print the text "Generated " and NumSamples and " samples at 440Hz" and newline
end program

skill_23.name: Real-Time Systems Engineer
skill_23.description: Build hard real-time systems with deterministic latency. Implement schedulers, priority inversion handling, and safety-critical code.

skill_23.example_snippet:

        Period as whole number
        Deadline as whole number
        Priority as whole number
        LastRun as whole number
    end shape

    keep Tasks as Task with values nothing and nothing and nothing

    action schedule takes T as ref Task, CurrentTime as whole number produces truth value:
        if the difference of CurrentTime and T.LastRun is at least T.Period then:
            put CurrentTime into T.LastRun
            produce success with true
        end if
        produce success with false
    end action

    keep T1 as Task with 10 and 10 and 1 and 0
    keep Now as whole number with value 15

    keep ShouldRun as truth value
    call schedule with T1 and Now giving ShouldRun
    print the text "Task should run: " and ShouldRun and newline
end program

skill_26.name: Automotive Software Engineer
skill_26.description: Develop software for ECUs, ADAS systems, and autonomous driving. Follow automotive safety standards (ISO 26262, ASPICE).
skill_26.example_snippet:
program CANParser:
    shape CANMessage holds:
        ID as whole number
        Length as whole number
        Data as byte with values 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0
    end shape

    action parse_speed takes Msg as const ref CANMessage produces whole number:
        # Speed in byte 0-1 (little endian)
        keep Low as whole number
        put Index at 0 of Msg.Data into Low
        keep High as whole number
        put Index at 1 of Msg.Data into High
        produce success with the sum of Low and the product of High and 256
    end action

    keep SpeedMsg as CANMessage with 0x123 and 2 and 0 and 50 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0 and 0
    keep Speed as whole number
    call parse_speed with SpeedMsg giving Speed
    print the text "Vehicle speed: " and Speed and " km/h" and newline
end program

skill_28.name: Scientific Computing Programmer
skill_28.description: Implement numerical methods, simulations, and high-performance computing kernels. Work with linear algebra, differential equations, and parallel algorithms.
skill_28.example_snippet:
program MatrixMult:
    action multiply takes A as raw handle to fractional number, B as raw handle to fractional number, 
                      C as raw handle to fractional number, N as whole number produces nothing:
        repeat N times using I:
            repeat N times using J:
                keep Sum as fractional number with value 0.0
                repeat N times using K:
                    keep AVal as fractional number
                    put Index at the sum of the product of I and N and K of A into AVal
                    keep BVal as fractional number
                    put Index at the sum of the product of K and N and J of B into BVal
                    put the sum of Sum and the product of AVal and BVal into Sum
                end repeat
                put Sum into Index at the sum of the product of I and N and J of C
            end repeat
        end repeat
    end action

    keep N as whole number with value 3
    keep A as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8
    keep B as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8
    keep C as raw handle to fractional number with room for the product of N and N and 8

    call multiply with A and B and C and N
    print the text "Matrix multiplication complete" and newline
end program

skill_31.name: Computer Vision Engineer
skill_31.description: Implement image processing algorithms, feature detection, and neural network inference for vision tasks. Optimize for embedded cameras.

        Pixels as raw handle to byte
        Width as whole number
        Height as whole number
    end shape

    action sobel_x takes Img as const ref Image, X as whole number, Y as whole number produces whole number:

skill_34.name: Game AI Programmer
skill_34.description: Implement AI behaviors, pathfinding, decision trees, and state machines for games. Build NPC brains and strategic planners.
skill_34.example_snippet:
program BehaviorTree:
    shape Node holds:
        method tick produces truth value:
            produce success with true
        end method
    end shape

    shape Sequence is a Node holds:
        Children as raw handle to Node
        ChildCount as whole number

        method tick produces truth value:
            repeat ChildCount times using I:
                keep Child as raw handle to Node
                put transmute Children as * raw handle to Node into Child
                keep Result as truth value
                call tick with Child giving Result
                if Result is equal to false then:
                    produce success with false
                end if
            end repeat
            produce success with true
        end method
    end shape

skill_35.name: Compiler Optimizer Engineer
skill_35.description: Implement compiler optimizations: constant folding, dead code elimination, loop unrolling, register allocation, and SSA form.
skill_35.example_snippet:
program ConstantFold:
    shape Instruction holds:
        Opcode as text
        Result as whole number
        Op1 as whole number
        Op2 as whole number
        IsConst1 as truth value
        IsConst2 as truth value
    end shape

    action fold takes Inst as ref Instruction produces truth value:
        if Inst.Opcode is equal to "add" then:
            if Inst.IsConst1 and Inst.IsConst2 then:
                put the sum of Inst.Op1 and Inst.Op2 into Inst.Result
                put true into Inst.IsConst1
                produce success with true
            end if
        end if
        produce success with false
    end action

    keep AddInst as Instruction with "add" and 0 and 5 and 3 and true and true
    keep Folded as truth value
    call fold with AddInst giving Folded
    print the text "Folded 5+3 = " and AddInst.Result and newline
end program

    shape Neuron holds:
        MembranePotential as fractional number
        Threshold as fractional number
        LeakRate as fractional number
        RefractoryPeriod as whole number
        LastSpikeTime as whole number
    end shape

    action update_neuron takes N as ref Neuron, InputCurrent as fractional number, 
                            CurrentTime as whole number produces truth value:
        if the difference of CurrentTime and N.LastSpikeTime is less than N.RefractoryPeriod then:
            produce success with false
        end if
        
        put the sum of N.MembranePotential and InputCurrent into N.MembranePotential
        put the difference of N.MembranePotential and N.LeakRate into N.MembranePotential
        
        if N.MembranePotential is greater than N.Threshold then:
            put 0.0 into N.MembranePotential
            put CurrentTime into N.LastSpikeTime
            produce success with true
        end if
        
        produce success with false
    end action
    
    keep N1 as Neuron with 0.0 and 1.0 and 0.1 and 5 and 0
    keep Spiked as truth value
    call update_neuron with N1 and 0.5 and 10 giving Spiked
    print the text "Neuron spiked: " and Spiked and newline
